description: This file contains utility functions to detect changed paths in a Git repository, classify the scope of changes for different platform and environment targets, and output the results for use in continuous integration workflows. It specifically handles scope detection for various platform-specific and technology-specific areas based on filename patterns, with some logic for command-line argument parsing and direct script execution.

methods.name: detectChangedScope
methods.description: Analyzes an array of changed file paths to determine which CI workflows should run, based on filename pattern matching for different platforms and projects.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Uses Git to list the changed file paths between two commits or branches.

methods.name: writeGitHubOutput
methods.description: Appends CI scope detection results as output variables to the specified GitHub Actions output file.
